entries.say.1.neutral: I didn't know you, {target.name}. You deserved better.
entries.say.2.neutral: I hope someone remembers your name, {target.name}.
entries.say.3.neutral: This place takes everyone, doesn't it?
entries.say.4.neutral: Someone should have found you sooner, {target.name}.
entries.say.5.neutral: Rest now, {target.name}. I won't leave you unnamed.
